## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser. Nothing to install.
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** the **tasks PDF** with your answers, before lecture 9.
  About 30 minutes.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary db-form db-query db-criterion db-report >}}

## Step 1 · A form: one record at a time {.study}

- A **form** shows **one record** of a table at a time, in big boxes.
- Click the table **Products**, then **Create › Form**. The arrows at the
  bottom go to the next record.
- A new record: **▶\*** (New record), type, then **Save**.

{{< sim file="sims/access-shop-form.html" poster="sims/access-shop-form.png" title="Access Lab: a form" height="680" >}}

## Step 2 · Queries: a criterion and a sort {.study}

- A **query** shows only the records that you ask for: **Create › Query
  Design**, then double-click the fields.
- The **criterion** goes in the **Criteria** row: `Drinks`, `>5`.
- The **sort** goes in the **Sort** row: **Ascending** (A to Z, small to
  big) or **Descending**. Then click **Run** (the red !).

{{< sim file="sims/access-shop-query.html" poster="sims/access-shop-query.png" title="Access Lab: a query on Products" height="680" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Queries"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Drinks|>5"}
You want only the products of the type Bags. What do you type in the Criteria row?
:   Bags

    Why: The criterion is the value that the records must have.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · A report: ready to print {.study}

- A **report** shows a table ready to print: click **Products**, then
  **Create › Report**.
- **Group & Sort › Add a group**: the records of each type together.
- **Totals › Sum**: the total of each group, and a Grand Total.

{{< sim file="sims/access-shop-report.html" poster="sims/access-shop-report.png" title="Access Lab: a report" height="760" >}}
